en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couplet on the Included (Pariyāpannaduka)

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and included [within the mundane], a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor reactive and is not included arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root-condition … pe … three under non-disappearance-condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not included, a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor reactive and is not included arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not included … [and so forth].

A non-visible-and-non-reacting, non-included state arises by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a non-visible-and-non-reacting, non-included state, both a non-visible-and-reacting, non-included state and a non-non-visible-and-non-reacting, non-included state arise by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] for root; for predominance, [there are six].
